semiconductor_relevance: High — Kitagawa Gress Tech specializes in CMP processing and precision polishing solutions critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Kitagawa Gress Tech provides comprehensive solutions for chemical mechanical polishing (CMP), including equipment, consumables, and process development tailored to customer needs. Their offerings range from desktop CMP machines to 300mm-compatible systems, along with polishing consumables and technical expertise in automation.
capabilities: CMP process development and demonstration testing
Manufacturing and sales of CMP machines
Sales of polishing consumables such as slurries and dressers
Customization and bespoke solutions for CMP processes
